title: KESA: A Knowledge Enhanced Approach For Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2202.12093v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Though some recent works focus on injecting sentiment knowledge into pre-trained language models, they usually design mask and reconstruction tasks in the post-training phase. In this paper, we aim to benefit from sentiment knowledge in a lighter way. To achieve this goal, we study sentence-level sentiment analysis and, correspondingly, propose two sentiment-aware auxiliary tasks named sentiment word cloze and conditional sentiment prediction. The first task learns to select the correct sentiment words within the input, given the overall sentiment polarity as prior knowledge. On the contrary, the second task predicts the overall sentiment polarity given the sentiment polarity of the word as prior knowledge. In addition, two kinds of label combination methods are investigated to unify multiple types of labels in each task. translated_title: KESA：一种知识增强的情感分析方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2202.12093v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：尽管近期一些工作专注于将情感知识注入预训练语言模型，但它们通常在后训练阶段设计掩码和重建任务。在本文中，我们旨在以更轻量的方式利用情感知识。为实现这一目标，我们研究了句子级情感分析，并相应提出了两种情感感知的辅助任务，称为情感词完形填空和条件情感预测。第一个任务在给定整体情感极性作为先验知识的情况下，学习选择输入中正确的情感词。相反，第二个任务在给定词语情感极性作为先验知识的情况下，预测整体情感极性。此外，我们研究了两种标签组合方法来统一每个任务中的多种标签类型。我们认为更多信息可以促进模型学习更深刻的语义表示。我们实现了...
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级知识增强方法，通过两种情感感知辅助任务（情感词完形填空和条件情感预测）将情感知识融入预训练模型，以提升句子级情感分析的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight knowledge-enhanced approach that integrates sentiment knowledge into pre-trained models via two sentiment-aware auxiliary tasks (sentiment word cloze and conditional sentiment prediction) to improve sentence-level sentiment analysis performance.
